summary: DigitalOcean Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into Equipment Finance Agreements dated September 10, 2026 with MUFG Americas Capital Leasing Finance, LLC as lessor and MUFG Bank as agent, providing up to $725 million of committed financing for data center equipment purchases, plus a $300 million accordion the company intends to exercise in full, reaching $1.025 billion. Advances fund up to 90% of equipment cost, the balance prepaid rent, priced at term SOFR plus 2.75%, amortizing through September 10, 2030, with a purchase option and title transfer. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
